fields.name: formsTheme

fields.description: Select only one option from each category.

fields.name: hideTitle
fields.label: Hide Forms title from being displayed?
fields.description: Needed if the Forms Title is required only for accessibility purpose and does not impart any additional visual information about the forms

fields.name: mail-subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Subject that is considered to be sent.

fields.name: mail-from
fields.label: From
fields.description: Email address that the message is considered to be sent from.

fields.label: To
fields.description: Email addresses where the messages will be sent.

fields.name: mail-cc

fields.description: Email addresses where the messages will be sent as a copy.

fields.name: mail-bcc
fields.label: BCC
fields.description: Email addresses where the messages will be sent as a copy.

fields.name: forms-endpoint
fields.label: Forms Endpoint
fields.description: Optional base URL for the form submission service. Uses the site origin when blank.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Alternative text for thank you screen image
